title: InterruptedException in HttpDownloader

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

body:
### Description of the problem / feature request / question:

Every second or third build or so I get an `InterruptedException`. Always in a specific `repository_rule`.
The code that breaks is:

    url = "http://ourownapache/libs/adrenosdk-linux-tar.xz"
    rule_ctx.download_and_extract(
      url,
      ".",
    ) 

This might be a regression in _0.4(.2)_ since we are still working fine at _0.3_. I did test _0.4.1_ before and did not have these exceptions, so it might be specific to _0.4.2_ but I am not sure.

### If possible, provide a minimal example to reproduce the problem:
Not sure how to reproduce. Might be specific to `.xz` archives!?

### Environment info
* Operating System: Ubuntu 16.04.1

* Bazel version (output of `bazel info release`): 0.4.2

###  Have you found anything relevant by searching the web? (e.g. GitHub issues, email threads in the [bazel-discuss@googlegroups.com](https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/bazel-discuss) archive)
Nope

### Anything else, information or logs or outputs that would be helpful?
